card.name: Just before an S unit abbreviation
card.fires_on: Partway through a dose or radiation measurement, one step before an expected S-starting unit or label such as Sv, Sr or %S. Seen in the middle of units like mcGy, mSv, µSv and (mCi), and on digits inside numbers.

modes.label: Radiation dose units
modes.description: Inside units such as mcGy, mSv or µSv in dosimetry tables, where Sv or Sr comes next.

modes.label: Brackets after a unit name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a spelled-out unit, before the abbreviation.

modes.label: Digits inside doses
modes.description: A digit within a decimal or strength figure in a dose or concentration list.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting a capital S, as in Sv, Sr or %S, and away from lowercase s.
card.plain: It fires inside dose and radiation units, just before an S-starting abbreviation like Sv is expected.
